author: Its almost like a scamm
title: The game wants to force you to spend money all the time
content: I was enjoyng to play this game as a relax break and it was very fun at first when I could only play without having to spend money. But the point about this game is to get to spend money so they do everything to force you this direction. For instance, they add required items into the design that are locked and to unlock and be able to pass to the next stage - guess what? You need to pay and buy to unlock the items - is not even to use it, its only to unlock. They spamm you all game with “offers” to buy coins and they are expensive!! Is not even a resenable price. Also after a few weeks playing and progressing suddely I was not winning anything. No matter how much effort I added to the design the score was always very low. So after weeks achieving higher ranks, out of the blue I was being downgraded round after round. My guess is that after they hook you the game starts to compare your design with a level different from you - a higher one. So it becomes impossible to get a good score. All of this to take money from you. I felt like I was being scammed. So I decided to delete my account.

author: VanVenetiglio
title: Good, but not more so interesting. The game now is totally “pay to PLAY”
content:
The game is, in general, very good. Good definition, nice materials...
But in these last revisions made by the developers, materials "disappeared" (and some I had), limited the amount of daily votes, and with that, the possibility to "win" coins from the game without buying. Also the values in star tokens to buy the new materials that come in, leave us pretty much without a choice.
In other words, it is becoming more than a "pay to win" game and effectively becoming a "pay to PLAY" game. I understand that the developers made the game to make money, of course. But I imagine that these changes must make many give up playing.
I buy the season pass, but rarely get to redraw most of the challenges, unless I spend real money so I can get more coins from the game.
The new "scoring" mode for players often makes the designs unfair, especially the duels. You can't have a person on level II or III competing equally with someone on level XIII or IX.
This is becoming boring and I am seriously considering, at the very least, stopping buying the season pass.
